teams.detail: Swept the weekend set with Toronto (11-0 behind an Arozarena grand slam Saturday, 4-0 on a Garver homer Sunday) to sit 47-44, 1st in the AL West. Open a three-game series at Miami tonight, 6:40 PM ET — game had not yet started as of this brief.

Vegas Summer League opens Thursday (7/9) vs. the 76ers, roster headlined by No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie. Off the court, Kevin Durant has reportedly voiced interest in joining Cade Cunningham in Detroit, and the Pistons are also floated as suitors for Anthony Davis in a deal centered on Jalen Duren.

Training camp opens July 24 in Renton (rookies report 7/17). Coach Mike Macdonald attended the USA-Belgium World Cup Round of 16 match at Lumen Field Monday (Belgium won 4-1); on the roster side, Ty Okada and 2nd-round rookie Bud Clark are competing for the safety job vacated by Coby Bryant's move to Chicago.

RB Jordan Washington is still targeting a late-July return from his spring injury as Jedd Fisch expresses confidence the Huskies have the physicality to compete in the Big Ten. UW also added a commitment from Colorado offensive lineman Reis Russell this week.

F Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to the Hornets in June, the 4th-highest German draft pick in NBA history. Danny Sprinkle continues rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, restocking around 2026 signee Lattimore Ford.

headlines.headline: Kawhi Leonard traded back to Toronto; Cavs lock up Donovan Mitchell on $273M extension
headlines.detail: Clippers send Leonard to the Raptors for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two future first-round picks, a first-round swap, and two seconds; Toronto plans to open extension talks with Leonard immediately. Cleveland separately signed Mitchell to a 4-year, $273M max extension.

headlines.headline: Commanders personnel exec Scott Fitterer departs for Athletes First
headlines.detail: Washington's front office loses Fitterer, a former Panthers GM, as the league settles into a quiet pre-camp stretch of waiver claims (Giants' C.J. Ravenell, 49ers' Gracen Halton) ahead of late-July report dates.

headlines.headline: Big 12 Media Days kick off in Frisco, opening a month of conference media day coverage
headlines.detail: Commissioner Brett Yormark's state-of-the-conference address led off the two-day event, the first of over a dozen media day events running through SEC Kickoff (July 20-23) as programs approach fall camp.

headlines.headline: Kansas lands No. 1 recruit Tyran Stokes; Duke adds transfer John Blackwell
headlines.detail: Kansas secures the top-ranked 2026-27 recruit as Duke, returning three starters from last season's No. 1 overall seed, adds the top-rated guard in the transfer portal.
